evidence_spans: However, under the same V/III ratio but with reduced beam fluxes (In BEP = 1.53×10-7 mbar, Sb BEP = 2.43×10-7 mbar), as the growth time is prolonged from 25 to 60 minutes, the nanowire length also increases from about 0.8 μm to a maximum of about 2.6 μm, whereas the diameter undergoes almost no significant change.
